portInfo.description: Bodrum Cruise Port markets a full cruise-port product with technical information, tariffs and guest services alongside ferry and yacht services. The castle dominating the harbour is the primary heritage stop for cruise passengers; ferry traffic shares the wider harbour complex — follow cruise signage.

climate.description: Typical Mediterranean climate with seasonal variations

politics.visaRequirements: Visa required for many nationalities. E-visa available online for most countries (varies by nationality).
politics.entryRequirements: Valid passport with at least 6 months validity. Some nationalities require visa in advance.
